insurance_business_line.label: Insurance business line
insurance_business_line.value: Commercial property and casualty insurance, property and casualty reinsurance, and high-net-worth personal lines.

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.label: Risk underwriting / distribution model
risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Decentralized primary underwriting through specialized businesses that select their own channels, including appointed agents and brokers. Also underwrites reinsurance.

premium_exposure_mix.label: Premium / exposure mix
premium_exposure_mix.value: Commercial P&C predominates, with facultative and treaty reinsurance and high-net-worth personal lines.

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Combined ratio [P&C underwriting]
combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: GAAP calendar-year combined ratio with underwriting expenses measured against net earned premiums. Separately reports the current accident-year combined ratio before catastrophe losses.

loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Loss / LAE ratio [P&C underwriting]
loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Net losses and loss expenses relative to net earned premiums. Separately reports the current accident-year loss ratio before catastrophe losses.

reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.label: Reinsurance / catastrophe protection
reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.value: Subsidiaries cede a broad portfolio of P&C reinsurance treaties to traditional reinsurers and to Lifson Re on a fully collateralized basis.

notes: Berkley’s asset–liability matching approach and reported solvency measure are unclear.
